class.name: NNConsiderations
class.brief_description: Base node for all Noodle Nodes consideration nodes.
class.description: The [method NoodleNodes.get_blackboard] family and [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] resolve through the owning [NNAgent] and its effective board and actor.

members.member: If this is set to [code]true[/code], the consideration forces the score to be 0.0 and ends the evaluation immediately. It can be set inside [method NNConsideration.on_evaluate], but the value is runtime state and is never saved with the scene.

The resulting score for the consideration after evaluation. It is set from the value returned by [method NNConsideration.on_evaluate], or from [member NNConsideration.activation_input_value] and [member NNConsideration.activation_curve] when that virtual is not overridden. The value is runtime state and is never saved with the scene.
